results.title: The Hybrids
results.overview: A thought-provoking documentary examining personal accounts of alleged alien abduction, hybridization, and non-human identity.

results.title: Casualty
results.overview: At the outset of Operation Desert Storm, a mortally wounded Kurdish surgeon reflects on his history—both personal and political—as he observes the bombing of Baghdad from a well outside the city.

results.title: bubble bubble
results.overview: Three pairs of artists engage in different instances of collaborative creation. As they get to know each other and discuss art and life, each pair creates an unexpected new work.

results.title: A Singapore Dementia Story
results.overview: An anthology of five short films by local filmmakers, each offering a unique perspective on living with dementia in Singapore.

results.title: NJPW G1 Climax 36 - Day 5
results.overview: The fifth night of G1 Climax 36 took place on July 22, 2026, at Aore Nagaoka in Nagaoka, Niigata, Japan, and was headlined by a B Block match between Zack Sabre Jr. and Callum Newman.

results.title: The Shot
results.overview: Miquel, an amateur comic illustrator, helps his cousin, the self-proclaimed “La Joyas”, to deliver a mysterious package that, without knowing it, contains the most valuable jewel of the history of soccer.

results.title: 13 Alfinetes
results.overview: Miracles still happen—or so they say… What is the place of the sacred in the contemporary world?  Looking again at a myth that haunts us, that of Saint Anthony of Lisbon (and also of Padua), through the timeless painting of Goya, 13 Alfinetes is a story of love, revenge, and blood. It begins with a reenactment of an episode supposedly occurring in medieval Lisbon, filtered through the cosmopolitan 18th-century Madrid, and returning to Lisbon today, where miracles, in truth, no longer happen.

results.title: Ulya
results.overview: A giant girl lives in a wild rural environment. When the modern world enters this isolated Russian Old Believer milieu, the girl is taken away and dragged into the world of professional sports. The aim does not differ much from that of a circus in the Middle Ages – to entertain audiences and exploit the limits of people’s mental and physical abilities. But the girl proves to have unbelievable willpower and athletic talent. She is able to adapt and triumph in this new world. This is the story of the famous basketball player Ulyana Semyonova.

results.title: I Fell, It's Fine
results.overview: When Anne, a guarded wellness-resort owner, meets an otherworldly woman named Chicks, her carefully controlled life begins to unravel in the most healing way.

results.title: Arnie & Barney
results.overview: A platoon of ants set out to save their community in the midst of a severe drought, but the hilariously inept Arnie and Barney – who are not cut out for heroics – decide to tackle the problem themselves. Their bumbling efforts lead them to uncover a shady water racket and team up with a secretive superhero mosquito. In a series of comical mishaps, they inadvertently save the meadow and become the most unlikely heroes of all.

results.title: Teodor Currentzis conducts Brahms and Mahler
results.original_title: Teodor Currentzis conducts Brahms and Mahler
results.overview: At Berlin’s Funkhaus, virtuoso pianist Alexandre Kantorow and star soprano Regula Mühlemann dazzle in this stunning program featuring Brahms’s Piano Concerto No. 2 and Mahler’s Symphony No. 4 alongside Teodor Currentzis and his renowned Utopia Orchestra.

results.title: Nowhere to Lay My Eyes
results.overview: With her brother, Sanghee visits her mother on Jeju Island. It’s been 10 years. Her mother's restaurant has become a hit. Her stepfather is making a film about a "grass tomb". His daughter has just started painting. Previously unknown facts, needless advice and cheap compliments are passed back and forth. On the morning of her departure, the other family members watch one of Sanghee's films.

results.title: Salbardi
results.overview: In Salbardi village, mysterious deaths spark fear. Officer Manorama investigates amid superstition, political pressure, and resistance. As mansion secrets and power struggles emerge, she battles mental strain seeking truth and justice.

results.title: Harrison Ford Comes to Wichita
results.overview: When Hollywood legend Harrison Ford makes his annual trips to Wichita, KS, the town buzzes with local folklore known as “Harrison Sightings."  For filmmaker Graham High, what begins as an investigation into a hometown mystery unfolds into something bigger. Harrison Ford Comes to Wichita is a feature-length documentary that explores an endearing American city, its unassuming locals, and the unexpected ways we find ourselves in the places we left behind.

results.title: Celeste & the Cyan Sun
results.overview: On her last day in Italy, a young woman finds herself swept away by a new intimate friendship towards reckless abandon and tragic circumstances.

results.title: La Fata
results.overview: Isabella, a young dominatrix and digital sex worker, embraces, interprets, and brings to life fantasies that defy definition.

results.title: Birthday Wishes: Christenings
results.overview: In the house of Líba and Arnošt, preparations for the christening are in full swing, which are to take place exactly according to Líba's detailed plan - including choosing the child's name. However, nothing goes as expected: daughter-in-law Simona secretly chooses a different name, Arnošt gets involved in a "detective" search for lost keys and a supposed theft, while Karel and his friend Richard solve a misunderstanding in a jewelry store. The chaos is compounded by the confused saleswoman Vlastička, who has lost her memory. As the day of the christening approaches, secrets surface, identities become clear, and family relationships are put to the test.

results.title: Splatter
results.overview: As a violent, supernatural force begins to hollow her out from the inside, a young woman must survive appointments with a gynaecologist who insists her gruesome physical symptoms are just part of being a woman.
